nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral asset token held in custody by the locker.
Immutable Loan contract address this CollateralLocker is attached to.
Sets the immutable collateralAsset and loan addresses.
Transfers amt of the collateral asset to dst; restricted to the Loan via the isLoan modifier.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == loan to authorize the caller.
Caller address used in the isLoan access control comparison.
External ERC20 transfer of collateralAsset to dst for amt, which may invoke arbitrary code on a malicious token.
Destination address for the collateral transfer.
Amount of collateral asset to transfer.
Constructor parameter supplying the collateral asset address.
Constructor parameter supplying the Loan address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against loan inside the isLoan modifier to authorize the caller.
The loan state variable is the trusted address used in the isLoan access control check.
The isLoan modifier gates execution of pull so only the Loan can call it.
pull performs an external token transfer to dst, which can hand control to a malicious token and enable reentrancy.
collateralAsset is the token contract on which safeTransfer is invoked.
The caller-supplied destination dst flows into the external transfer call as the recipient.
The caller-supplied amount amt flows into the external transfer call as the value.
Constructor parameter _collateralAsset is assigned to the collateralAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter _loan is assigned to the loan state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: dst is the transient transfer recipient consumed only by the safeTransfer external call in pull.
amt is the transient transfer amount consumed only by the safeTransfer external call in pull.
_collateralAsset is a transient constructor input used only to initialize the collateralAsset state variable.
_loan is a transient constructor input used only to initialize the loan state variable.
